In this role, you will help maintain secure, available, and responsive databases while supporting system upgrades, data migrations, and evolving business needs. The successful candidate will bring hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration experience, along with familiarity with Azure SQL and cloud-based data migration tools. This position is suited to a detail-oriented problem solver who can collaborate with technical teams and users to strengthen database performance, security, and reliability.
